reason: Rewrote the core builder tests from the old New MBR / Refresh all / carried-over flow to the ticket's new authoring loop: head + toolbar (Preview + amber Lock month, no theme toggle), amber draft banner, 'Insights added' completion bar, bucket 'N KPIs' + insights sub-count, KPI rows, the Carried pill, filled-insight background, and the 800ms-debounced / blur-flush insight autosave stamping lastEditedAt.

The per-bucket lock/unlock/amendment lifecycle is removed by this ticket; repurposed the file to pin that the old handle-collecting lock modal, unlock/amendment-note flow and per-bucket lock badge/Unlock control are gone, replaced by the single amber 'Lock month' toolbar action (handler wired by a later ticket), and that builder edits never PUT a locked snapshot.

The old toolbar (New MBR / Refresh all / Discard / Lock in MBR snapshot, all .icon-btn) is replaced; rewrote it to assert the redesigned toolbar's exactly-two actions — a Preview .icon-btn and an amber .btn.warn-primary 'Lock month' — their order, type=button, and the absence of any theme toggle.

The editable value <input> is gone (the value cell is now display-only via MetricValueCell) and the status select now carries the token-based .status-select class; updated the CSS-token and behaviour assertions to the .status-select / .insight-input(.filled) controls actually rendered.

The shell was redesigned: bucket headers moved from .bucket-card__head/__name/__count ('N metrics') to .bucket-head/.bucket-name/.bucket-count ('N KPIs') + .bucket-sub, the draft notice is now .local-banner.draft, and the header/toolbar sit in a .head-row; updated the structural assertions accordingly while keeping the shared de-scoped .page-head header check (still shared with the Data model view).

The build-slot dispatch test asserted the removed 'New MBR' button was present; updated it to assert that the redesigned build slot no longer renders that button, keeping the slot-dispatch coverage (all six tests) intact.
